title: Colts' No. 1 WR Alec Pierce carried to sideline medical tent, carted off field with heel injury in OT loss to Chiefs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts' No. 1 WR Alec Pierce carried to sideline medical tent, carted off field with heel injury in OT loss to Chiefs
sources.description: Pierce is the Colts' No. 1 receiver and has led the NFL in yards per reception in each of the last two seasons. He signed a four-year, $114 million contract in the offseason to remain with the Colts.
